description: Synthetic Chinese and English text for evaluating SQLite FTS5 candidates.
provenance: Original synthetic text authored for the PatchouliLib evaluation; not adapted from an external corpus.

documents.title: 帕秋莉检索与安全重试
documents.summary: 讨论知识库查询、幂等写入和版本冲突。
documents.body: 这是一份完全合成的会话归档。Agent 使用 If-Match 更新当前版本，并在响应丢失后复用幂等键。

documents.title: 中文备份恢复演练
documents.summary: 验证备份、恢复和引用一致性。
documents.body: 恢复后检查页面修订与引用，避免把旧索引当作当前内容。

documents.title: SQLite FTS5 中英混合查询
documents.summary: Agent retrieval for a synthetic 中文知识库。
documents.body: The synthetic Agent checks deterministic ranking，并验证中文检索能力与当前修订。

documents.title: Idempotent archive retry
documents.summary: A synthetic example of safe retry behavior.
documents.body: Reuse the same operation key after a lost response. If-Match protects revision updates.

documents.title: Literal search syntax
documents.summary: FTS-looking input stored as ordinary synthetic text.
documents.body: The words AND OR NOT are data. It also records "quoted", unmatched"quote, prefix*, title:demo, alpha OR beta, NEAR(alpha beta), and the literal combination (alpha OR beta) NEAR(gamma delta).

documents.title: Prefix expansion decoy
documents.summary: A document used to expose accidental wildcard matching.
documents.body: This synthetic document mentions prefixable content. The terms alpha beta gamma delta appear nearby without the literal operators.
